reported.title: Mode switch changes extend the stair light timer
reported.description: onModeChange() calls armTimer() whenever the light is lit (lines 40-43), which resets litSince and restarts the 3000 ms window on every D3 edge. The spec requires D3 to have no effect on D9, but the measured pulse from 517 ms lasted 5483 ms instead of 3000 ± 150 ms, and a bouncing switch produced a 4787 ms pulse. The mode-change handling must not touch the light timer. 1 of 1 pulse(s) had the wrong length: pulse from 517 ms lasted 5483 ms, expected 3000 ± 150 ms.

truth.description: Changing the mode switch while the light is on restarts the 3 s timer, so the light stays on longer than the press allows; the press and the mode switch are each correct on their own

truth_for_judge.description: Changing the mode switch while the light is on restarts the 3 s timer, so the light stays on longer than the press allows; the press and the mode switch are each correct on their own

exposing_checks.behaviour: D9 pulse length around None ms (tolerance 250 ms) (A press lights the stairs for 3 s)

judge_input.spec:
- Stair light relay on D9; push button on D2 and mode switch on D3, both with internal pull-ups (active LOW).
- A settled press on D2 turns D9 HIGH for 3000 ms, starting within 100 ms of the press.
- A press on D2 while D9 is HIGH is ignored and does not extend the light.
- Changing D3 has no effect on D9, whether the light is on or off.
- D9 stays LOW whenever no press has been accepted.
- Print `stair mode=<0|1> lit=<0|1>` every 1000 ms, where mode is the level of D3.
